documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Guidelines, Clark Atlanta University (CAU AI Guidelines)
documents.stance_why: The document says "the decision to incorporate these technologies into teaching and learning is at the discretion of the instructor" and offers three course categories, "Open Use, Limited Use, and No Use", so it sets no stance itself and lists tiers.
documents.summary: University guidelines from the CAU AI Task Force that tell every instructor to put an AI policy on the syllabus and choose Open, Limited or No Use. It lists considerations for each category and supplies recommended syllabus wording.

units.why: The guideline says "All instructors should have an AI course policy included on their syllabus." This tells instructors to state AI expectations in the syllabus, so P09 (not P04, which is about who decides).
units.anchor: All instructors should have an AI course policy included on their syllabus.

units.why: The purpose statement says the guidelines aim "to prepare scholars for the AI-driven workforce", a career rationale for teaching AI use, so P44.
units.anchor: to prepare scholars for the AI-driven workforce.

units.why: Frames generative AI as part of "our educational toolbox, just as dictionaries, calculators, and web searches"; a welcoming default framing, so P02, informational in modality.
units.anchor: can be part of our educational toolbox, just as dictionaries, calculators, and web searches

units.why: Defines generative AI as something that "can be used to create new content in response to prompts", setting what the guidelines cover, so P61.
units.anchor: Generative AI can be used to create new content in response to prompts.

units.why: States AI "can be an effective tool that scholars can use to enhance their learning and understanding"; a positive framing coded P02 (welcoming) rather than P44 because it is not about careers.
units.anchor: AI can be an effective tool that scholars can use to enhance their learning
units.frag_end: every facet of how we teach.

documents.title: Clark Atlanta University Sample Syllabus Template
documents.stance_why: The only AI text is that "Faculty should consult the CAU Artificial Intelligence Guidelines document and then insert their AI-Use expectations", leaving the stance to each instructor.
documents.summary: Official sample syllabus template with a single AI section that sends faculty to the AI Guidelines. The rest is general syllabus boilerplate.

units.why: The template tells faculty to "consult the CAU Artificial Intelligence Guidelines document and then insert their AI-Use expectations in this section" of the syllabus; a required AI statement slot: P09.
units.anchor: Faculty should consult the CAU Artificial Intelligence Guidelines document
units.frag_end: in this section of the syllabus.
units.policy: Faculty should consult the CAU Artificial Intelligence Guidelines document and then insert their AI-Use expectations in this section of the syllabus.

notes: No School of Arts & Sciences or CS-department AI policy found in searches. Student Handbook 2025 (cau.edu/sites/default/files/2025-12/Student-Handbook-2025.pdf) was not fetched or checked for AI text.
